371f4c64b3359213: The sequencing reads in each fastq file were first split between mouse and human using Xenome (Conway et al., 2012). Only reads unambiguously assigned to either mouse or human were kept and respectively aligned to their reference genome (mouse: GRCm38.p5, human: GRCh38.p10) through the HTSeqGenie v4.35 Bioconductor package (Pau and Reeder, 2012, https://doi.org/10.18129/B9.bioc.HTSeqGenie). First, reads with low nucleotide qualities (70% of bases with quality <23) or matches to rRNA and adapter sequences were removed. Then, reads were aligned using GSNAP (Wu et al., 2010; Wu et al., 2016) version ‘2013-10-10-v2’, allowing maximum of two mismatches per 75 base sequence (parameters: ‘-M 2 -n 10 -B 2 -i 1 -N 1 -w 200000 -E 1 --pairmax-rna=200000 --clip-overlap'). Transcript annotation was based on the Gencode genes database (human: GENCODE 27, mouse: GENCODE M15). Reads unambiguously mapping to exons were counted to get gene-level read counts.

Supplementary files format and content: gene_counts.xlsx provides gene-level counts of reads unambiguously mapping to exons. There is one table for the reads assigned by Xenome to the Mus Musculus genome (originating from the mouse alveolar type 2 cells of the organoids in the well), and one table for the reads assigned to the Homo Sapiens genome (originating from the human fibroblasts of the organoids in the well).
Supplementary files format and content: plate_design.csv contains the sgRNA sequences used to target each gene and their location on the four plates.

Supplementary files format and content: imaging_outputs.csv contains the main outputs of the image analysis performed on each well at day 7 and day 14, in terms of number or organoids in the well, average area of the organoids in the well, and estimate of the percentage of the well covered by organoids.
Supplementary files format and content: xenome_stats.csv contains the summary of the sequencing read assignment made by Xenome (Conway et al., 2012).
73c0d23232ae1c8e: SpaceRanger v3.0.1 was run on the raw sequencing data, then aligned to gene expression counts using the mm10-2020-A reference genome from 10x, and the Visium v2.0 mouse transcriptome probeset.
High resolution H&E images were aligned with the CytAssist image using the landmark-based alignment tool in Loupe browser
Aligned H&E images were integrated with expression data (at the 8um bin size) using custom scripts to generate a SpatialData ZARR.
Supplementary files format and content: LIB[#]_SAM[#].sd.zarr.tar.gz: Gzipped SpatialData object
Supplementary files format and content: [SLIDE_ID]-fiducials-image-registration.json: Manual registration file for Visium coordinates to high-resolution H&E
Supplementary files format and content: LIB[#]_SAM[#]_spaceranger.tar.gz: Gzipped raw SpaceRanger outputs
Supplementary files format and content: LIB[#]_[CAPTUREAREA]_[SLIDE_ID]_[CAPTUREAREA]_[SAMPLE].tiff: CytAssist image associated with registration file
